counterexamples: A caller that reads the returned count is unaffected.

defects.evidence: stock.py reserve no longer raises OutOfStock and returns a possibly smaller count; checkout.py ignores the return value and relied on the exception. checkout.py is deliberately not captured.
defects.fix_or_counterexample: Keep raising, or make every caller use the returned count.
defects.impact: The order is confirmed for the full quantity although fewer units were reserved, so stock is oversold.
defects.match_criteria: Identify that reserve no longer raises when stock is short, so a caller that relied on OutOfStock or ignores the returned count proceeds as if the full quantity were reserved.
defects.trigger: Check out an order for more units than remain in stock.
